ideas.text: An AI that detects when a coworker is about to tap you on the shoulder and turns on your noise-canceling headphones automatically.
A bot that maps the hot desk power dynamics of your floor and assigns you a seat accordingly.
An app that detects microwaved fish in the office kitchen and sends an anonymous note to the perpetrator.
A tool that tracks the thermostat adjustment history of a floor and names the primary combatants.
An AI that measures the acoustic radius of the one person who takes every call on speaker and sends a perimeter alert.
A bot that monitors the office fridge for items that have been there longer than they should be and escalates.
An app that detects when a meeting room was booked for a solo call and publicly shames the booking.
A tool that calculates how much desk space has been colonized by personal items and generates an eviction timeline.
An AI that identifies the optimal desk on any given floor based on light, noise, and proximity to the coffee machine.
A bot that detects when a phone booth is being used for lunch and removes the booking privilege.
An app that converts open office noise levels into a productivity estimate and tells leadership what they're paying for.
A tool that detects when someone is about to start a 30-minute conversation at the person's desk and sends a rescue Slack.
An AI that maps where the office introverts sit and protects a quiet zone around them by blocking calendar invites.
A bot that detects when someone has been using the standing desk in sit mode for 3 months and removes the height adjustment.
An app that detects fragrance levels above a sensory threshold and sends a facilities request automatically.
A tool that identifies which shared printer has the highest complaint-to-resolution ratio and places a warning label.
An AI that detects when a whiteboard drawing has not been erased in 3 weeks and archives it before anyone has to have a conversation.
A bot that detects when someone turned the office music to a genre that only they like and queues a neutral playlist.
An app that tracks who never cleans up after themselves in the kitchen and generates a quarterly report for facilities.
A tool that detects when a shared space has been booked for the same recurring meeting for 18 months and asks if it's still needed.
An AI that assigns a seat based on your actual noise output rather than where you arrived first.
A bot that detects when someone eats crunchy food in a quiet area and mutes their desk for 15 minutes.
An app that monitors how long the printer queue has been stuck and estimates how many documents were lost to indifference.
A tool that generates a desk etiquette document based on whatever is currently going wrong on your specific floor.
An AI that detects when a colleague has started a conversation and has clearly not noticed you are in the middle of something.
A bot that converts an anonymous office complaint into a facilities ticket with the right escalation path.
An app that tracks how many minutes per day are lost to people asking where the good meeting rooms are.
A tool that detects when a floor's noise level peaks and schedules the most important work for the quiet window before 10am.
An AI that maps the office gossip network and tells you who to avoid if you want something to stay private.
A bot that detects when a meeting room is empty but still showing as booked and automatically releases it.
An app that identifies the office temperature setting that maximizes collective productivity and locks the thermostat there.
A tool that detects when someone has been sitting at a bookable desk for 6 hours after their booking ended.
An AI that routes your focus work to the quietest desk available at any given hour without you having to check.
A bot that detects when a new office plant was purchased, logs its likely date of death based on historical care patterns.
An app that estimates how many productive hours were lost on your floor today due to open plan noise and reports it to the CFO.
A tool that detects when the coffee machine has been empty for 45 minutes and hasn't been refilled by anyone responsible.
An AI that identifies the desks with the best natural light and runs an equitable lottery for hybrid workers who care.
A bot that detects when someone put an item in the office fridge without a name or date and sends a countdown.
An app that tracks how long the office dish situation has been unresolved and names the escalation level.
A tool that detects when an open plan office is running below 30% capacity and suggests everyone go home.
An AI that detects when a coworker's speakerphone call could be heard from 4 desks away and suggests alternatives.
A bot that converts 'the office vibes are off today' into a root cause analysis.
An app that tracks when your favorite desk is taken and predicts when it will be free again based on the occupant's calendar.
A tool that detects when a team meeting has spilled out of a room and is happening in the middle of the open floor.
An AI that identifies the one person whose presence makes every nearby desk less productive and maps the blast radius.
A bot that detects when the 'quiet zone' sign is being ignored and escalates the violation appropriately.
An app that monitors the amount of time you've been on a call at your open desk and suggests moving to a phone booth at minute 4.
A tool that detects when the communal snack bowl is consistently eaten by 2 people and generates a fairness audit.
An AI that detects desk-creep — the gradual expansion of one person's belongings into adjacent workspaces — and triggers a gentle boundary.
A bot that identifies which open office amenities have the highest disappointment-to-promise ratio and tells facilities.
An app that monitors office humidity, CO2, and lighting and sends an alert when the conditions are making everyone tired.
An app that detects when your headphones are in but a coworker taps your shoulder anyway and sends them a PSA.
A tool that measures how much time is lost per day to people asking 'is anyone sitting here?' on a reserved-desk floor.
An AI that detects when the office AC war has escalated to passive-aggressive sticky notes on the thermostat.
A bot that identifies which coworker consistently takes the last cup of coffee and never makes more.
An app that detects when a 'quick question' from a neighbor has entered its 12th minute and plays an exit sound.
A tool that generates a seating chart that maximizes productivity and minimizes the number of people who can see your screen.
